notes.title: Welcome to Snow Country
notes.content:
I tried to get a new version out for the start of the Steam Winter Sale, but I only managed to get it done today, sorry for the delay.

The big winter update contains a new winter theme (called "Snow Country") with five new tracks, a new game mode (Time Attack) and new analog controls.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26689939/19825029db4bc0a1c3118b3534f3830382e110d7.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]A new HD winter theme
[*]Five new tracks
[*]New game mode: Time Attack - drive alone on a track to get the best time on the online leaderboards
[*]New analog controls: Now you have finer control over your car if you use the sticks or analog triggers of your controller
[/list]

Have fun racing, thanks for playing Brumm and Happy Holidays!

Stefan

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow racers,

first, a big thank you to everyone who has purchased Brumm! You guys rock :-)

The first update was just released, addressing some issues from the forum and adding some addtional features. There are some smaller cosmetic changes like a clearer ranking screen after a race and some bigger changes like the bots and custom matches.

[b]AI Bots and Custom Matches[/b]
The AI bots were reworked completely and should be quite challenging now. In fact they are so good, you can now configure the level and number of bots for a match. Also you can now customize stuff like number of laps or which tracks you want to drive for both online and local play.

[b]What's next[/b]
Over the next weeks I will add new tracks with much more varied layout and much better graphics, better car graphcis, a new race mode (time race online against your ghost), an updated elimination mode, achievements and some other features.

Thanks again
And hope you have fun,
Stefan
